title: WASiM Model
description: Canonical model definition for a probabilistic, dynamic (Monte-Carlo) simulation. Describes a directed graph of typed elements — inputs, functions, stocks, discrete events, reliability, financial, and mass-transport elements — driven over time across one or more stochastic realizations. Vendor-neutral: the vocabulary follows general stochastic-simulation / system-dynamics conventions and is independent of any particular authoring tool or file format.
$comment: UNIT CONTRACT. Every `unit` and `*_unit` field is a free-form unit string (e.g. 'm3/yr', 'kg/m3', '1' for dimensionless). This schema does NOT validate units structurally — dimensional correctness is the producer's responsibility. The engine resolves each string to SI at load time using the companion unit registry units.json ($id 'https://wasim.dev/schema/units/0.1.0'), which maps each recognised unit string to an SI conversion factor and dimensional base; an unrecognised string is a load-time error, not a schema error. Where units attach: a scalar's unit lives on its own quantity; per-axis units (array.unit, timeseries.times_unit/values_unit, lookup.x_unit/y_unit, convolution.response.*_unit) apply to a whole array; a computed element's result unit is declared in element_base.outputs[].unit. Bare-number fields documented as inheriting a unit (min_value, constant.bounds, controller.bounds, distribution.truncation) take the unit of the value they bound, or may be given as a quantity to state the unit explicitly.

wasim_version.description: WASiM schema version this file conforms to (semver).

source.description: Provenance metadata. Not consumed by the engine.

elements.description: Flat list of all model elements. Hierarchy is expressed via container references.

time_history_displays.description: Display-only expressions recovered from result/plot elements in the source model. Not part of the simulation graph; preserved for inspection. Accepts the same provenance fields as element_base (source_type, source_object_id, path, input_ports).

connections.description: Directed connection graph extracted from the source model's connection/influence layer. Edges are keyed by source_object_id (a surrogate key — the source model's per-object stream index), NOT by the string element id/name. The two id-spaces ARE joinable within this document: every element and container carries its own source_object_id, so an edge's from_id/to_id resolve to elements/containers by matching that field (see connection_edge). Not consumed by the engine; preserved as the model's connectivity.

simulation_settings.description: Time-stepping and Monte-Carlo controls for a simulation run.

sampling_method.description: Sampling scheme for stochastic inputs: simple Monte-Carlo or Latin hypercube.

seed.description: RNG seed for reproducibility. Null for random.

reporting_periods.description: Optional reporting/output intervals at which results are recorded (each a duration quantity). Independent of the computation timestep; empty/absent records at every timestep.

connection_edge.description: One directed edge of the connection graph. from_id/to_id/edge_id are u16 surrogate keys (the source model's per-object stream index), deliberately integer so they do not collide with the string element id/name keyspace. These integer ids ARE resolvable within this document: each element and container carries its own source_object_id, so from_id/to_id join to elements/containers by matching that field (no external map needed).

edge_id.description: u16 connection identifier, unique within the source model.

from_id.description: u16 source_object_id of the source element; resolves to the element/container whose source_object_id equals this value.

to_id.description: u16 source_object_id of the destination element; resolves to the element/container whose source_object_id equals this value.

waypoints.description: Visual wire-path pixel coordinates [x, y]. Empty for direct connections.

quantity.description: A numeric value with explicit unit declaration. The value is expressed in the declared unit — not necessarily SI base units. The engine converts to SI at load time for internal computation. display_unit controls how the value is presented to users in the frontend (defaults to unit if absent).

value.description: Numeric magnitude in the declared unit.

unit.description: Unit of value (e.g. 'mm/yr', 'kg/m3', 'd', '1' for dimensionless). A free-form unit string carrying the source model's display-unit string verbatim (e.g. 'pers/d', 'KAF/yr', 'kpers'); not necessarily a canonical vocabulary term and not validated structurally here. The engine normalises it to SI at load time via the unit registry (units.json, $id 'https://wasim.dev/schema/units/0.1.0'); an unrecognised string is a load-time error. See the top-level $comment for the full unit contract.

display_unit.description: Presentation form of the unit for frontend display and user input. If null, defaults to unit. The engine ignores this field.

quantity_expr.description: A value that may be either a fixed quantity or an expression AST.

quantity_or_formula.description: A value that may be a fixed quantity, a parsed expression AST, or a formula string referencing other model elements. Prefer the expression_field (AST) form when the transpiler can parse the formula — engines should consume the AST directly. The string form is a fallback for unparsed formulas; engines that don't carry their own parser should treat unparsed strings as 0.0 and emit a warning.

oneOf.description: Unparsed formula expression (fallback when transpiler parse failed).

unit.description: Result unit of this output (free-form unit string; see the unit contract in the top-level $comment and units.json).

dimensions.description: Ordinal-set element ids this output is dimensioned over (empty = scalar).

trigger_spec.description: Describes WHEN an element fires, resamples, or applies a change. A generic event/timing condition shared by event generators, resampled random variables, discrete events, consequences, and failure modes.

mode.description: Firing rule. 'always': every timestep. 'on_condition': when the boolean condition becomes true. 'periodic': at a fixed recurrence period. 'on_schedule': at explicit times. 'on_event': when an upstream event element fires.

condition.description: Boolean condition that fires the trigger when mode is 'on_condition'.

source.description: Element id of the upstream event/signal that fires this trigger when mode is 'on_event'.

schedule.description: Explicit event times when mode is 'on_schedule'.

flux_spec.description: A mass (or energy) transfer between transport cells or media.

mechanism.description: Transfer process: bulk advective flow, Fickian diffusion, a direct transfer, settling, or precipitation/dissolution exchange.

rate.description: Advective flow rate (volume or mass per time) for advective mechanisms.

coefficient.description: Diffusive conductance / mass-transfer coefficient for diffusive mechanisms.

species.description: Element id of the transported species this flux carries; null = all species in the source cell.

medium.description: Element id of the medium the flux moves through.

target.description: Element id of the destination cell/pathway.

gate_node.description: One node of a reliability/fault-tree, event-tree, or reliability block diagram. Combines child component states into a higher-level state. Discriminated by 'op'.

oneOf.description: Logical AND / series gate — true only if all children are true.
Logical OR / parallel gate — true if any child is true.
Logical negation of its single child.
k-out-of-n voting gate — true when at least 'threshold' children are true.
Leaf referencing another element/component whose state feeds the tree.

reference.description: Element id of the referenced component.

oneOf.description: Leaf evaluating a boolean condition expression.
Leaf basic-event / input state.

input.description: Element id of the input/basic-event state.

failure_process.description: How a component fails and is restored over time.

basis.description: What drives failure: calendar/exposure time, accumulated operating time, per-demand probability, capacity-versus-demand comparison, an external event, or a boolean condition.

time_to_failure.description: Distribution of time (or number of demands) to failure.

policy.description: How the component is restored: not repaired, repaired in place, replaced, or restored on a preventive-maintenance schedule.

demand_capacity.description: For 'capacity_demand' basis: the capacity threshold the demand is compared against; failure occurs when demand exceeds capacity.

trigger.description: For 'event'/'condition' basis: what fires the failure.

medium_ref.description: Reference to a `medium` element present in a transport cell, with an optional volumetric fraction.

fraction.description: Volume fraction of the cell occupied by this medium.

species_ref.description: Reference to a `species` element tracked in a cell/source, with an optional initial amount.

kind.description: Structural role. 'container'/'group': purely organizational. 'submodel': a nested simulation that runs with its own clock/sampling controls (see simulation_settings) and exposes a named interface.

parent.description: ID of parent container, or null for top-level.

simulation_settings.description: For kind='submodel': the nested run's time-stepping/Monte-Carlo settings. Null inherits the parent model's settings.

interface.description: Named inputs/outputs exposed at the container boundary (for submodels and groups). Each entry is an element id within or feeding the container.

source_type.description: Original element kind in the source modelling tool (e.g. 'Container', 'Group', 'SubModel'). Engine ignores.

source_object_id.description: Original object id from the source model, for round-tripping. Engine ignores.

path.description: Full container path in the source model. Engine ignores.

ast_node.description: A single node in a WASiM expression AST. Discriminated by 'op'.

oneOf.description: Numeric literal with optional unit.
Reference to another element's output.
Reference to a simulation time property.
Binary arithmetic or logical operation.
Unary operation.
Built-in scalar function call.
Inline ordered array constructed from scalar expressions. Used for vector/array operations. Equivalent to a vector(a, b, c) constructor.
If/then/else conditional.
Evaluate a lookup-table element at a given input. The element_id must refer to an element of type 'lookup'. The engine interpolates into that table using the evaluated input.

element_id.description: ID of the lookup element to evaluate.

input.description: Expression for the lookup's independent variable.

input2.description: Second independent variable for 2D lookup tables (optional).

oneOf.description: A source-model function the engine does not implement. Preserves the call (name + args) for round-tripping and inspection; the engine treats it as opaque/NaN. Use 'call' for functions in the implemented fn enum; use 'extern_call' for everything else so argument refs (and thus connectivity) are still preserved.
The implicit iteration index inside a vector()/matrix() comprehension body (see 'vector_map'). 'row' is the array/first axis; 'col' the matrix second axis.
Array/matrix element access: array[i] or matrix[i, j]. 'indices' holds one expression for a vector access or two for a matrix access.
Comprehension over an ordinal set: evaluate 'body' (which may reference 'index_ref') once per member of the set 'over', producing an array dimensioned over that set.

over.description: Ordinal-set element id the result is dimensioned over.

expression_field.description: Reusable bundle of AST + optional display string.

display.description: Human-readable expression string. Not consumed by the engine.

source.description: How the expression was recovered. 'explicit' = decoded directly from the source model (formula text or token table). 'inferred' = legacy generic inference (kept for backward compatibility). 'inferred_path' = port-path reference like '\Container\Element' resolved to a passthrough. 'inferred_passthrough' = single-incoming-connection passthrough. 'inferred_container' = container-boundary passthrough. 'inferred_ts' = name-convention time-series passthrough (e.g. Precip -> Precip_TS). 'inferred_pool_rate' = pool rate AST built from inflow/withdrawal port bindings rather than an inline formula. 'inferred_ast' = compiled-AST node graph (no formula text) decoded into structured AST nodes. 'inferred_stub' = formula extraction failed; placeholder Literal(0.0) emitted with connection-derived inputs to preserve graph topology. Engines should treat the 'inferred_*' sources as approximate and may warn.

process_spec.description: Parameters for a stochastic process element. Values are in user-chosen units; the engine scales drift linearly with dt and stddev by sqrt(dt/T_ref) at each timestep.

family.description: 'gbm' = geometric Brownian motion: lognormal per-step increments, no memory between steps.

mean_type.description: Interpretation of the 'mean' parameter. 'geometric': mean is the per-period compound growth rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.07 for 7%/yr); engine derives log_drift = ln(1 + mean). 'arithmetic': mean is the arithmetic expected return; engine applies Ito correction (log_drift = ln(1+mean) - sigma^2/2). 'log_drift': mean is the log-space drift directly, no transformation.

mean.description: Central tendency of the process. Interpreted according to mean_type. Use the same unit as the intended output (e.g. '1/yr' for an annual return rate).

stddev.description: Per-reference-period volatility. Engine scales to per-step diffusion as sigma_step = stddev.value * sqrt(dt / T_ref) where T_ref is the period implied by stddev.unit. Annual volatility of 15% -> stddev = {value: 0.15, unit: '1/yr'}.

truncation.description: Optional bounds clipping the sampled value (each in the variate's own unit).

correlation_group.description: Named correlation group for rank-correlation sampling.

oneOf.description: Lognormal parameterized by the mean and stddev of the underlying (non-log) variable rather than of its logarithm.
PERT / beta-PERT distribution defined by an optimistic min, most-likely mode, and pessimistic max.
Pareto (power-law tail) distribution.
Generalized extreme-value / Gumbel distribution.
Extreme-probability distribution (probability-weighted extreme value).
Student's t distribution.
Poisson count distribution.
Binomial count distribution: number of successes in n independent trials.
Negative-binomial count distribution: number of trials until a target number of successes.
Beta-binomial count distribution: binomial with a beta-distributed success probability.
Discrete uniform over an integer range.
Bernoulli distribution: 1 with probability p, 0 otherwise.
General discrete distribution with an explicit probability-mass table.

outcomes.description: Outcome values (e.g. 1.0, 2.0, ... 6.0 for a six-sided die).

probabilities.description: Probability of each outcome. Must be same length as outcomes and sum to 1.

oneOf.description: Empirical distribution defined by a cumulative-probability (CDF) point table.
Empirical distribution defined by an explicit set of equally- or unequally-weighted sample values (resampled directly).

weights.description: Optional weights, same length as samples.

oneOf.description: Externally- or Bayesian-defined distribution whose form is supplied outside the model. Parameters are kept free-form for round-tripping.

parameters.description: Free-form parameter bag describing the external definition.

definition.description: Reference or name of the external distribution definition.

element_base.description: Fields common to all element types.

id.description: Unique identifier within the model. Used for cross-references.

container.description: ID of the containing container, or null for top-level.

source_type.description: Original element type from the source modelling tool (e.g. 'Pool', 'Integrator', 'Reservoir', 'Stochastic'). Preserves source-side semantics that may collapse to the same wasim type. Engine ignores.

source_object_id.description: Original object id from the source model, for round-tripping. Engine ignores.

path.description: Full container path in the source model (e.g. '\System_Model\Tailings\Reclaim_from_Tailings'). Engine ignores; preserved for diagram rendering and cross-referencing port-path passthroughs.

input_ports.description: Richer connection metadata alongside 'inputs[]'. Each entry names a source element and, when known, the specific output port on the source and input port on this element. Engine consumes 'inputs[]'; this field is provenance for renderers/round-tripping.

output.description: Name of the upstream element's output port that feeds this connection, if known.

input.description: Name of this element's input port that the connection terminates on, if known.

oneOf.description: Fixed scalar value, optionally editable at runtime.

editable.description: If true, value can be adjusted by the user at runtime without editing model.json.

bounds.description: Optional valid range. A bare number is interpreted in the element's own unit; a quantity may state the unit explicitly.

oneOf.description: Constant 1-D array of scalar values, indexed positionally (1..N by convention). All values share a single unit. Consumers (e.g. vinterp / interp_array) operate on the values vector directly.

mode.description: Sub-discriminator for the constant array shape.

values.description: Array values in declared unit. Empty array indicates the values are not yet extracted from the source model (see 'provenance').

provenance.description: Origin of the values vector. 'extraction_pending' means the type was inferred from consumer usage but the array body has not been decoded; consumers should treat values as unavailable.

oneOf.description: Samples from a probability distribution each realization. Value is constant within a realization unless a resampling trigger is set.

autocorrelation.description: Lag-1 autocorrelation coefficient (0-1). Applied across simulation time steps within a realization.

resampling.description: When the variable resamples during a realization. Null/absent = sample once per realization.

trigger.description: Legacy resampling-trigger provenance (e.g. resample on a specific signal). Engine treats per-step resampling identically regardless of trigger; prefer 'resampling'.

source.description: Name or kind of the trigger that fires resampling. Common values: an elapsed-time index, 'Timestep'.

correlations.description: Cross-correlations with other random variables in the model.

oneOf.description: Re-draws from a stochastic process at every timestep. Each realization gets independent draws at each step, modeling sequence-of-outcomes risk. Unlike random_variable (which draws once per realization), variance of cumulative outcomes grows with horizon. Engine scales stddev by sqrt(dt/T_ref) automatically; drift scales linearly.

lower_bound.description: Optional floor clamped on the per-step drawn value, expressed as a quantity in the same unit as process.mean. null = no bound. For GBM, lognormal increments are naturally bounded below by -1 (total loss); set lower_bound only to impose a tighter floor or when using a non-lognormal family.

oneOf.description: Computes a value from other elements via a mathematical expression. Also covers boolean/logical combinators (and/or/not), which are encoded in the AST.

inputs.description: Element IDs referenced by this expression. Redundant with the AST; used for fast dependency graph construction.

oneOf.description: Conditional switch. Evaluates ordered cases and returns the value of the first whose condition is true; otherwise the default. Selection may also be index-based via selector_input.

selector_input.description: Element id of the discrete index/signal that selects a case, when selection is index-based rather than condition-based.

condition.description: Boolean condition (or index match) selecting this case.

value.description: Value returned when this case is selected.

default.description: Value returned when no case matches.

oneOf.description: Reduces several inputs (or a single input accumulated over time) to one value via an associative operation (sum, product, min, max, mean; or their running/over-time variants).

operation.description: Reduction applied. 'running_*' accumulate over simulation time.

over.description: Reduce across the listed inputs, or accumulate a single input over simulation time.

operands.description: Explicit operand expressions when the summands are formulas rather than plain element references.

reset.description: For running_* operations, when to reset the accumulation.

oneOf.description: Integrates a net rate over time. State variable with initial condition. Pure integrator (the net rate is supplied directly); see 'pool' and 'reservoir' for stocks with discrete inflow/withdrawal accounting.

initial_expression.description: Expression evaluated at t=0 to compute the initial state. When present, overrides initial_value. Used when the initial condition is computed from other elements.

rate.description: Net rate of change per timestep (d/dt of state). The transpiler is responsible for encoding inflows minus loss formulas as a single rate expression.

min_value.description: Lower bound enforced after each timestep (stocks cannot go below it). A bare number is interpreted in the stock's own unit; a quantity may state the unit explicitly. Default 0.

capacity.description: Upper bound on state value. Null for unbounded.

inputs.description: Element IDs referenced by the rate expression.

inflows.description: Element IDs that contribute mass/value to this accumulator (additive). Source-semantic decomposition of the rate; redundant with rate.ast. Engine consumes rate.ast.

requests.description: Element IDs that draw mass/value from this accumulator subject to availability (subtractive). Paired with 'inflows[]'. Engine consumes rate.ast.

oneOf.description: A stock that accounts for discrete inflows and prioritized withdrawals. State rises by inflows and falls by withdrawals subject to availability, bounded below by min_value and above by capacity. Withdrawals are served in priority order.

initial_expression.description: Expression evaluated at t=0 to compute the initial state; overrides initial_value when present.

withdrawals.description: Subtractive draws, served in ascending priority order subject to availability.

capacity.description: Upper bound on the stock. Null = unbounded.

min_value.description: Lower bound enforced each timestep. A bare number is interpreted in the stock's own unit; a quantity may state the unit explicitly.

oneOf.description: A stock with finite capacity that spills/overflows above capacity and may release a controlled lower outflow. Models reservoirs, tanks, and similar bounded storages.

inflow.description: Net inflow rate into the reservoir.

capacity.description: Storage capacity; volume above this spills.

overflow_target.description: Element id receiving spill/overflow above capacity.

lower_outflow.description: Controlled release rate drawn from the reservoir.

min_value.description: Lower bound enforced each timestep. A bare number is interpreted in the reservoir's own unit; a quantity may state the unit explicitly.

oneOf.description: Externally supplied time-varying input, interpolated between data points.

times.description: Time coordinates, monotonically increasing, in times_unit.

values.description: Values at each time coordinate, in values_unit. Must be same length as times.

oneOf.description: Table-based interpolation mapping one (or two) independent variables to an output.

y.description: Dependent variable values (1-D lookup). Same length as x.

columns.description: Output columns for a 2-D lookup table. Each inner array has the same length as x. Use input2 to select the column (1-indexed).

extrapolation.description: Behavior when input is outside the x range.

oneOf.description: Embedded or linked tabular data source (spreadsheet). Holds a cell grid (optionally formula-bearing) and/or a link to an external workbook, exposing named ranges as model values.

links.description: Named ranges exposed as inputs/outputs of the element.

external_file.description: Path/reference to a linked external workbook, if any.

oneOf.description: Outputs a time-lagged version of an input signal (information/signal delay). The value is delayed but not otherwise transformed.

input.description: Element ID of the signal to delay.

initial.description: Value to return before the lag duration has elapsed.

oneOf.description: Mass-conserving transport delay: material entering is released after a transit time, optionally attenuated by first-order decay and spread by dispersion. Unlike 'delay' (a pure signal lag), this conserves the integral of the throughput.

input.description: Element ID of the throughput entering the delay.

decay_rate.description: First-order loss rate applied to in-transit material.

dispersion.description: Spread of the transit-time distribution (0 = plug flow).

oneOf.description: One-timestep memory: outputs the value its input held at the previous timestep (the initial value before the first step). Used to break algebraic loops and model lag-1 feedback.

input.description: Element ID whose previous-step value is returned.

initial.description: Value returned at the first timestep.

oneOf.description: Convolves an input signal with a response (transfer) function — e.g. a unit hydrograph or impulse response.

input.description: Element ID of the signal to convolve.

response.description: The response/transfer function, either an explicit table or a reference to a lookup/timeseries element supplying it.

oneOf.description: Element id of a lookup/timeseries supplying the response function.
Feedback controller that drives a controlled variable toward a setpoint, with optional proportional/integral/derivative gains and output bounds.

controlled.description: Element id of the process variable being controlled.

gains.description: Controller gains. Omit terms that are unused.

bounds.description: Optional valid range. A bare number is interpreted in the element's own unit; a quantity may state the unit explicitly.

oneOf.description: Distributes a constrained supply across competing demands in priority order. Each demand receives up to its request, limited by remaining supply.

supply.description: Total available supply: a fixed quantity, a formula, or the element id of a source.

supply_source.description: Element id supplying the available amount, when supply is connection-bound rather than inline.

limit.description: Cap on what this demand may receive.

oneOf.description: Splits a single input flow into several outputs by fixed or computed fractions.

input.description: Element ID of the flow being split.

target.description: Element id receiving this fraction of the flow.

fraction.description: Share of the input routed to target (fractions across splits typically sum to 1).

oneOf.description: Procedural computation block for expressions requiring iteration or local variables.

source.description: Raw script source text (human-readable; engine uses expressions).

expressions.description: Transpiler-parsed AstNode expressions, one per evaluable output formula. Index 0 is the primary output. Log-message formulas are excluded. Absent when no formulas could be parsed.

variables.description: Local variable names in declaration order. Index 0 is the implicit result variable (self-reference). Absent for scripts using the alternate binary format.

procedural.description: True if the source script body contains procedural opcodes (control flow / multi-statement assignments) that the engine cannot faithfully execute under Tier 1. Engines should warn when evaluating procedural scripts; expression-only scripts (false) are correctly evaluable as a single formula.

oneOf.description: Named ordered array of scalar values, each computed from an expression. Supports vector patterns where multiple related quantities are grouped and operated on together (sum, mean, indexing).

mode.description: Sub-discriminator for the expression-based array shape.

values_unit.description: Unit shared by all elements of the array. Use '1' for dimensionless.

expressions.description: Ordered list of scalar expressions that constitute the array elements.

labels.description: Optional human-readable label for each element. Must match length of expressions if present.

inputs.description: Element IDs referenced across all expressions.

oneOf.description: Generates discrete events on a schedule, at a (possibly stochastic) rate, or when a trigger fires. Each event may carry a value/magnitude consumed by downstream consequence elements.

rate.description: Mean event rate for rate-based (e.g. Poisson) generation.

event_value.description: Value/magnitude carried by each generated event.

count_limit.description: Maximum number of events over the run.

oneOf.description: On each trigger, selects one outcome at random from a weighted set — a discrete stochastic branch.

value.description: Value produced when this outcome is chosen.

target.description: Element id taken when this outcome is chosen (branch destination).

trigger.description: When a new outcome is drawn.

oneOf.description: When its trigger fires, applies one or more changes/consequences to target elements (e.g. a discrete change of a stock or parameter).
Halts or pauses the simulation (or ends the current realization) when its condition becomes true.

condition.description: Boolean condition that triggers the interrupt.

action.description: What happens when the condition fires.

oneOf.description: Tracks a discrete status/state derived from a condition (e.g. on/off, ok/failed/degraded).

condition.description: Expression whose value sets the status.

states.description: Ordered labels of the possible states.

oneOf.description: Boolean decision element. Evaluates a true/false condition each timestep; carries a condition but no continuous output value.

condition.description: Boolean condition expression text recovered from the element (e.g. 'LSLeak_Count > 0'). Raw formula string; may be unparsed.

oneOf.description: Milestone marker. Fires when its trigger condition becomes true; carries an optional time marker.

trigger.description: Trigger condition expression text (e.g. 'ETime > 0 day', 'abs(MB) > Allowable_Error'). Raw formula string.

marker.description: Time marker quantity (e.g. a day/datetime offset) when recoverable.

oneOf.description: Discrete change delay. Applies a change value after a fixed delay; has no trigger condition.

delay.description: Delay duration before the change applies (a time quantity, e.g. {5,'day'}).

oneOf.description: Discrete change event. On its trigger, applies a change value to a downstream element. The trigger is often event-graph bound (fired by a separate event element).

trigger.description: Trigger condition expression text (e.g. 'ETime > 9 hr', 'Bank_Account < 0$'). Raw formula string; may be absent when the trigger is event-graph bound.

change.description: Change value applied on trigger. A fixed quantity (e.g. {10000,'$'}) when the change is a single scalar, or an expression AST when computed (e.g. round(Birth_Splitter.Males)).

oneOf.description: Timed event. Fires on a recurrence schedule rather than a state condition.

recurrence.description: Event recurrence/period text — the event period or frequency. May be a period ('1/30 day'), a rate ('0.05 day-1'), or an expression. Kept as the raw recovered string.

oneOf.description: A component failure-and-restoration process for reliability simulation. Produces a binary up/down (or capacity) state over time driven by a failure process, optionally applying consequences on failure.

consequences.description: Effects applied to other elements when this failure mode activates.

oneOf.description: A fault tree, event tree, or reliability block diagram. Combines component states through logic gates (AND/OR/NOT/k-of-n) into an overall system state.

root.description: Root node of the gate tree.

semantics.description: Whether the tree evaluates the probability of system success (reliability block diagram) or system failure (fault tree).

oneOf.description: Maps component/subsystem states to actions or consequences — the operational logic layer of a reliability model.

condition.description: State condition under which the action fires.

oneOf.description: An interest- or return-bearing balance (financial account). Grows by a (possibly stochastic) return rate and is adjusted by contributions and withdrawals.

return_rate.description: Per-period rate of return applied to the balance.

withdrawals.description: Element ids drawing on the account.

oneOf.description: Invested principal that earns a (possibly stochastic) return over time.
A scheduled stream of payments or receipts (negative amounts denote outflows).

amount.description: Payment amount per occurrence (negative for an outflow).

target.description: Element id of the account the flow settles into.

oneOf.description: A contingent-claim instrument (option) whose payoff depends on an underlying value relative to a strike.

underlying.description: Element id of the underlying value.

exercise.description: When/whether the option may be exercised.

oneOf.description: An indemnity contract (insurance): pays claims above a deductible up to a coverage limit in exchange for a premium.
A mixing cell / control volume that holds species across one or more media, with partitioning between media and first-order decay. The fundamental node of a mass-transport network.

media.description: Media present in the cell (e.g. a solid and a fluid phase).

species.description: Species tracked in the cell with optional initial inventory.

inflows.description: Element ids of pathways/sources delivering mass to the cell.

partitioning.description: Equilibrium partition coefficients between media within the cell.

oneOf.description: Carries mass between transport cells via one or more flux mechanisms (advection, diffusion).
